caption: A tree sways in the wind on a sunny day, and the pattern of leaf shadows on the ground beneath it shifts and dances.

sa.check: A tree sways in the wind.
The pattern of leaf shadows on the ground beneath it shifts and dances.
The shadows are a pattern of leaf shapes, not one solid shadow.

pc.expect: The shadow pattern moves in time with the branches and settles when the wind drops.
pc.fail: It is still while the branches sway; or it dances while the tree is still; or it moves out of time.

pc.expect: The pattern is dappled light and leaf-shaped shadows, not a solid shape.
pc.fail: It is one solid disc; or a geometric pattern unlike leaves; or it forms a recognisable object.

pc.expect: The pattern lies on the ground away from the sun, under the tree's crown.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or far from the tree; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The branches move only with the wind.
pc.fail: They whip about in still air; or move against other wind signs; or a branch detaches.
The tree duplicates or vanishes; or a branch vanishes; or the shadow pattern becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tree's leaves and the ground stay the same, and the shadows stay dark.
pc.fail: The leaves change colour; or the shadows turn coloured; or the ground changes.
